text:
maria-support: Customer AcmeSupply says invoice INV-2026-0315 shows PO 'PO-123' in their portal view, but the correct PO is 'PO-123456789'. They were charged yesterday and want the invoice reissued with the right PO. Screenshot attached.

jake-billing: ack — are funds captured or just authorized? we need to know if we should do a refund+reissue or a credit.

maria-support: captured. charge_id: ch_3G7fK. Customer insists PO must appear on final invoice for their accounting.

sophia-eng: this looks like our portal's OCR/truncation heuristic dropping trailing digits when non-numeric chars present. filing quick check. can you paste the raw invoice JSON or portal payload?

maria-support: pasted payload from support console: `{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0315",
  "po_field": "PO-123",
  "notes": "uploaded via pdf_ocr v1.2"
}`

eli-cs: thanks. customer provided original PO in email: `PO-123456789`. They uploaded a scanned PO page. we think OCR trimmed after dash.

sophia-eng: reproducer on staging: when pdf_ocr v1.2 sees pattern `PO-123456789` in a scanned line with low contrast it sometimes normalizes to `PO-123`. we can patch heuristics but that will take a day. immediate workaround: manual edit of invoice metadata and reissue.

sara-ops: manual edit flow: use internal tool /admin/invoices/{invoice_id}/edit -> update `po_field` then run "reissue_and_refund" job. note: for captured charges we do refund -> create credit invoice -> create new invoice -> capture. that will create two accounting events.

andrew-finance: confirm we should do refund + create new invoice (with same amounts) then capture. need GL codes: revenue account stays same; record refund under refunds GL-220. Also need to include note: "Reissued for PO correction per customer request" for audit.

maria-support: customer requests not to delay payment reconciliation — asks if we can reissue and mark as reconciled same day. Any fast path?

sophia-eng: we can't change captured transaction id; ops can issue a refund (same day) and re-capture immediately on the new invoice. takes ~30-45 min depending on gateway.

eli-cs: i'll message customer: offer expedited refund+recharge and confirm reconcilation ETA ~1hr.

qa-bot: QA checklist for reissue: [x] verify PO field updated in invoice JSON, [x] verify new invoice PDF shows PO, [ ] verify webhook to customer/accounting is triggered, [x] confirm refund succeeded.

sara-ops: running internal command now: `POST /admin/invoices/INV-2026-0315/actions/reissue` payload: `{ "update": { "po_field": "PO-123456789" }, "refund_original": true, "capture_new": true }`

sara-ops: refund succeeded: refund_id rf_9aBc, new invoice INV-2026-0315-R1 created and charged charge_id ch_3G7k. new PDF shows full PO.

maria-support: Customer confirmed they received new invoice PDF and the PO is correct :white_check_mark: they asked if we can prevent future OCR truncation.

sophia-eng: created internal ticket INC-3456 for OCR heuristics and pdf_ocr v1.2 -> v1.3 patch; will add unit test for long PO tokens. estimated PR tomorrow.

deploy-bot: INC-3456 linked to repo redwood/portal#482.

andrew-finance: update accounting: record refund rf_9aBc, post new capture ch_3G7k, add audit note. closing on our side once finance confirms GL entries.

maria-support: thanks team. Logging follow-up: send customer brief note about fix timeline and make a link to INC-3456.

eli-cs: sent to customer: "We've reissued the invoice with the correct PO and processed a same-day refund and recharge. The engineering team will patch OCR heuristics; ticket INC-3456."

maria-support: thread resolved from support perspective. leaving open for eng until INC-3456 merged.
